impl.summary: Added automatic Gravity Forms provisioning (plugin Forms\GravityProvisioner + CLI\GravityCommand): when Gravity Forms is active, "Contact" and "Initial Application Inquiry" are built via GFAPI with the specified fields, notifications (recipients from Settings → Forms, replyTo = email merge tag, [HK9 …] subjects) and confirmations (message / redirect to /thank-you/), marked with hk9_provisioned={role,version,plugin,time}, ids stored in forms.gravity_*_form and forms.provider switched to gravity only when both ids were empty. Entry points: Settings → Forms panel ("Create the Heartland forms in Gravity Forms" / "Re-create / update", admin-post hk9_gravity_provision with manage_options + dedicated nonce arg), `wp hk9 gravity provision [--force]` / `wp hk9 gravity status [--format=json]`, a new `hk9/import/finalized` action fired by Import\Steps\Finalize (non-dry runs) and admin_init(5) on Settings → Forms / Setup & Import (only when GF active, ids empty, no run recorded). Idempotent (stored/marked forms kept or adopted, never duplicated); --force updates in place (field ids stable, entries + hand-added notifications kept) and re-creates trashed/deleted forms; nothing is ever deleted; status reports drift (trashed/inactive/missing/outdated). Theme: rewrote _gravity-forms.scss (Orbital theme chosen and documented) so GF forms pixel-match the built-in form — measured geometry identical at 1440 and 390 (labels/inputs/button positions equal; 523 of 1.99M px differ at 1440 = sub-pixel AA of "* Required"); FormProviders now filters gform_required_legend ("* Required") and gform_validation_message (built-in summary sentence) for hk9-gf-form forms; fixed GF-reset side effects (select text centring, placeholder size, required-marker line height, validation summary focus border/gap, spinner hidden, consent/radio styling, half columns at the 768 breakpoint). Docs (ARCHITECTURE §2/§10, admin-guide Forms section + where-to-edit table, install §A6/§B.5/§D5, import Next steps) and tests (tests/gravity-test.php, 27 checks) added; sections-test made provider-independent. Local site left on provider=gravity with forms #26 (Contact) and #11 (Initial Application Inquiry); builtin toggled once and verified.

review.verdict: REQUEST CHANGES. Core provisioning is solid (definitions match the canonical arrays, idempotent, never deletes, dry-run/GF-inactive guards hold, cap+nonce correct, contact form pixel-equivalent, axe clean, no CSS leakage), but --force rewrites a hand-picked client form, the application form does not match the built-in one it claims to mirror, and the documented "install GF before the import" path seeds notifications with the wrong recipients.

findings.issue: provision_role() (lines 349-375) applies merge_for_update() to ANY live form stored in forms.gravity_*_form when $force is set, marker or not. Verified on the stack: a tmp form with one custom field set as gravity_contact_form → provision(true) replaced its fields with Name/Email/Subject/Message, renamed it "Contact (1)" and stamped hk9_provisioned. The panel shows the force button even when status says "a form picked by hand; left as is", so one click destroys a client-built form's fields.
findings.fix: In provision_role(): if $force && (marker($existing)===null || marker role !== $role) do NOT update in place — either GFAPI::add_form() a new marked form and store its id (leave the hand-picked form untouched) or return action 'skipped' with a message. Hide/disable the force button and add a test (force_leaves_unmarked_form_alone).

findings.issue: application_definition() diverges from Forms\ApplicationForm: applicant_type is a SELECT "I am a" (Select one / Veteran / Family member of a veteran / Other) in the built-in form but a RADIO "I am a…" (A veteran / A family member…) in GF; textarea label "Tell us about yourself" vs "Tell us a little about yourself and what you are looking for"; button "Submit Inquiry" vs "Send Inquiry". Measured: GF form 734px vs 699px at 1440, 1179 vs 1128 at 390 (screenshots app-form-{gravity,builtin}-1440.png). Settings panel text and admin-guide promise "the same fields as the built-in forms".
findings.fix: Use select_field($f['type'], 'I am a', ApplicationForm choice labels, 'Select one', true, 'gf_left_half'), label 'Tell us about yourself', button 'Submit Inquiry' (or change the built-in to match and fix docs); bump VERSION so status flags existing forms.

findings.issue: maybe_auto_provision() runs on the first visit to Setup & Import (page hk9-import), i.e. BEFORE the import writes forms.*_recipients. Config::recipients() then falls back to admin_email, so both GF notifications are seeded with the admin address; because last_run is recorded, should_auto_provision() is false at hk9/import/finalized and they are never re-seeded. install.md recommends installing GF before the import, which makes this the documented path.
findings.fix: Remove $is_import from maybe_auto_provision() (let the finalize hook provision after Options ran), or in on_import_finalized() refresh the hk9_admin notification 'to' when last_run.by === 'auto'. Add a test for the pre-import visit.

findings.fix: Add 'errorMessage' => __('First Name and Last Name are required.') to name_field().

fix.summary:
Applied every finding from the review (2 medium, 1 high, 3 low) plus the extra wiring they needed, re-ran the suites, rebuilt CSS and re-measured both pages.

HIGH – `--force` on a hand-picked form: `provision_role()` now checks the marker before `merge_for_update()`; a selected form without the `hk9_provisioned` marker, or one marked for the other role, returns action `skipped` with a message ("… was not created by Heartland … left as is. To use the Heartland definition, clear the selection under Settings → Forms and run Create again.") and is never written. `status()` gained `marker_role`; the settings panel only renders the force button when it has something to update/re-create (a marked form of the right role, or a trashed/missing one), its confirm text and description say hand-picked forms are left alone, and `wp hk9 gravity provision` warns on `skipped`. Tests: force_leaves_unmarked_form_alone, force_skips_other_role_form, panel_hides_force_for_hand_picked_forms.

MEDIUM – application definition aligned with `Forms\ApplicationForm`: "I am a" select (`ApplicationForm::applicant_type_options()`, new public helper shared by both providers — Veteran / Family member of a veteran / Other, placeholder "Select one", `gf_left_half`, required), textarea label "Tell us about yourself", button "Submit Inquiry". `GravityProvisioner::VERSION` = 2, so existing forms show drift; the stack's provisioned forms #26/#11 were updated in place with `wp hk9 gravity provision --force` (status: both OK, v2; notification recipients unchanged).

MEDIUM – pre-import seeding: the Setup & Import screen no longer triggers `maybe_auto_provision()` (Settings → Forms only; the import's `hk9/import/finalized` hook provisions after the Options step). Additionally `provision()` records what each notification was seeded with (`hk9_gravity_provision.seeded[role] = {to, fromName, from}`, via new `notification_seed()`), and `on_import_finalized()` — when forms already exist — calls `refresh_seeded_notifications()`: each value still equal to its recorded seed is re-seeded from the imported settings (`GFFormsModel::update_form_meta(...,'notifications')`), values edited in Gravity Forms are never overwritten, changes are logged through `$ctx->info()`. Tests: pre_import_seed_uses_admin_email, import_finalized_refreshes_seeded_notifications, import_finalized_keeps_edited_notification, import_screen_does_not_provision.

LOW – Name field message: `errorMessage` added, but GF's `set_required_error()` always appends "Please complete the following fields: …" to it, so the real fix is a `gform_field_validation` hook in `FormProviders` (hk9 forms only): "First Name is required." / "Last Name is required." / "First Name and Last Name are required." A companion `gform_form_validation_errors` hook drops GF's "Label: " prefix in the summary list so it reads like the built-in list.

LOW – SCSS: summary links now `.gform_validation_errors ol a` (outranks Orbital's rule) with no border/radius, underline, colour #7f1d1d; checkbox/radio `box-shadow: none`. Note: the built-in summary links are `color: inherit` = #7f1d1d (measured rgb(127,29,29) on the built-in form), not #b91c1c as the finding stated — matched the built-in, not the suggested value. CSS rebuilt (forms.css 37.3 kB / 5.5 kB gzip).

LOW – docs: ARCHITECTURE §10, admin-guide and install.md updated (select/label/button, Settings → Forms as the only screen trigger, seed refresh, hand-picked forms never rewritten, `marker_role`, `seeded`); the admin-guide panel screenshot regenerated.

fix.integration_notes: Nothing committed (per instructions). Behaviour changes to be aware of when merging: (1) `GravityProvisioner::VERSION` is 2 — any site with v1 forms shows drift until `--force` / 'Re-create / update' is run; the definitions (select instead of radio, label, button) only reach existing forms through that update. (2) `provision()` now returns action `skipped` for a selected form without the right marker; callers that switch on actions (CLI handled; the admin notice just prints the message).
